summary_en: 800,000 shares (3.9% of shares outstanding) up to ¥200M via market purchase. Execution window Jun 18, 2026 to Mar 31, 2027. Method: discretionary trading agreement. Stated rationale: flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice of Resolution Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Aeria Inc. resolved at its board meeting on June 10, 2026 to acquire up to 800,000 treasury shares (3.9% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum expenditure of ¥200 million. The acquisition will be conducted via market purchase under a discretionary trading agreement from June 18, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The board cited the need for flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions as the rationale. As of May 22, 2026, the company held 877,274 treasury shares against 20,372,154 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The company notes that execution may be partial or withheld depending on market conditions.
